categories_thin: Optometry: only one independent optometrist surfaced in the zone (Old Bridge Vision Center on US-9); the other Sayreville eye care listing (Visionworks, 426 Raritan St) is a national chain and was excluded
Orthodontics: no standalone independent orthodontic practice was verified in the zone; braces are offered by Dental City Sayreville and a multi-office corporate group that was excluded

Dermatology, podiatry, ENT and other medical specialties: no independent specialty practices found with a Sayreville/Parlin address - local specialty care appears to be hospital-affiliated and therefore excluded

Mental health counseling: the Psychology Today Sayreville listings are almost all telehealth-only sole practitioners with no business address, so only one counseling entity with an address was included
Yoga and Pilates studios: none found inside the zone; the nearest options listed were in South Amboy and Old Bridge
Medical spas: thin - most Sayreville spa listings are massage/reflexology rather than physician-supervised aesthetics
caveats: Google Maps returned a limited (roughly 4-result) list per query without signing in, so Maps coverage here is a floor, not a full census

Several BestProsInTown profiles are cross-filed under neighboring towns (Old Bridge, Edison, South Amboy) even when the street address is Sayreville; town field follows the street address, not the directory's filing
US-9 / Bordentown Ave addresses near the Old Bridge line (1018 US-9, 1026 US-9, 1040 US-9, 984 US-9, 4450 Bordentown Ave) need a municipal boundary check before outreach

Chains and franchise locations were excluded: Hair Cuttery (2909 Washington Rd), Hand & Stone Massage and Facial Spa (1048 US-9), Retro Fitness (2909 Washington Rd), Visionworks (426 Raritan St), Kessler Rehabilitation Center (2909 Washington Rd), Eastern Dental (2909 Washington Rd)
Two Birdeye 'dentist' entries carried malformed addresses (postal code 110034, not a New Jersey ZIP) and were excluded rather than guessed
Shared-address entries (152 Main St salon suites, 811 Washington Rd, 2909 Washington Rd, 1400 Main St) may be separate suites or booth renters - listed separately and flagged where they look related

Individual barbers and stylists who rent booths and are listed only on booking platforms (e.g. one barber at 118 Main St on Booksy, one at 777 Washington Rd on Fresha) were not listed as separate businesses
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap/Overpass was not used - the API is typically blocked here and the brief said not to spend time on it
YellowPages, Superpages, Manta, ChamberOfCommerce.com and NPIDB/NPIprofile returned HTTP 403 from this environment, so their full category lists could not be read
BestProsInTown has no dentists/physicians/chiropractor category pages for Sayreville (404), so those came from Maps and Birdeye instead
Sayreville Borough's own site has no public directory of licensed health or personal-care businesses that could be read
Phone numbers are Unknown for many listings - they were left blank rather than guessed; the triage team can pull them from each business's site
